notes: Window: header lines, the Preamble's seven 'Kwa kuwa' (whereas) clauses, the proclamation, and Article 1. Derived from udhr-swh.txt's own bytes independently of the English golden. Two genuine structural divergences: (1) the proclamation's object ('TAARIFA HII...') sits in its own blank-line-set paragraph after 'BARAZA KUU linatangaza', and that object paragraph is itself a full copula sentence of its own ('...kama ndio nguzo ya juhudi...', 'is indeed the pillar of effort...') — read as ITS OWN row rather than forced into the proclamation's object, where it would sit outside that row's self-verified span; (2) Article 1 verbs 'born free' and 'equal in dignity/rights' SEPARATELY, each with its own subject and copula, where English folds them into one predicate. 15 rows against English's 13.
